scientific_integrity: Uses the proved zero-product theorem of arXiv:2610.30209v1, clearly separated from the newly established infinite-rank conclusion. No fabricated numerical or external certification.
scientific_limitations: One complex Gaussian Fock variable, finite-length products, harmonic entire components of exponential type, algebraic rank on the common invariant domain; no assertion about boundedness, compactness, or Schatten behavior of alternative realizations. Prior analytic-kernel theorem is a premise; independent expert audit and priority assessment remain outstanding.
title: Infinite-rank rigidity for finite products of harmonic Fock Toeplitz operators
